rationale: 24fps W=5 spans 0.208333s; at12fps integer W=3 is0.25s, W=2 is0.166667s. Both quantization sides and phases are retained, not label-tuned. Confirmation spans (N-1)/fps remain 0.083333s and0.166667s. Alpha12=1-(1-alpha24)^2 preserves the scalar exponential time constant, not exact SO3 trajectories.
thresholds: Unchanged base45/20deg/s; geodesic speed divided by actual decoder dt
reindexing: Detector frame_index is sample ordinal; source_frame_index retained. Missing source frames remain ordinal gaps, never bridged. Actual decoder timestamps retained.
settling: Not run: 9-frame blocks, support and reference counts would require a separately declared time-based design. Settling is not movement end.
real_inference_gate: Before inspecting outcomes: all raw/EMA phase/window conditions must retain every24fps candidate with known start/end, have no extra candidates, and shift boundaries by <=1/12s. A24fps unknown boundary or no complete first event prevents qualification. This is reference fidelity, not correctness or clinical validation.
